name: Tiến lên
summary: Vietnam's shedding card game where players race to empty their hand by beating same-type combinations, with bombs to beat Twos.
rules_text: Deal 13 cards each from a 52-card deck to 4 players, clockwise. Card rank 3 low to 2 high, suits Spades < Clubs < Diamonds < Hearts. Goal is not to be last with cards. Player with 3 of Spades leads first pile with any valid set: single, pair, triple, four of a kind, straight of 3+ cards, or double straight of 3+ consecutive pairs. Twos cannot be in straights. In turn each player must play a higher same-type set where higher is determined by highest card rank then suit, or pass. Once passed you are out for that pile. When all others pass, winner of pile collects it and leads next pile with any set. Bomb exception: any four of a kind or double straight of 3+ pairs beats a single 2; double straight of 4+ pairs or four of a kind beats a pair of 2s; longer doubles beat triple 2s. Bombs may be played out of turn. When you play last card you exit. Last player with cards loses.
rating_reason: Shedding card game, hidden hands, strategic sequencing
